title: US Economic Calendar: one item per release
description: The upcoming FOMC, CPI, NFP and PCE releases with New York and UTC times and the official source of each date.

type.title: Release type
type.description: FOMC for a Fed rate decision, CPI for consumer prices, NFP for nonfarm payrolls, PCE for the PCE price index.

title.title: Release name
title.description: The official name of the release, such as Consumer Price Index.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Who publishes it: the Federal Reserve, the Bureau of Labor Statistics or the Bureau of Economic Analysis.

reference_period.title: Reference period
reference_period.description: The month the figures cover, such as October 2026. Empty for an FOMC decision.

date.title: Date (New York)
date.description: The release date in New York, as YYYY-MM-DD.

time_new_york.title: Time (New York)
time_new_york.description: The release time in New York, 24-hour clock, as HH:MM.

utc.title: Time (UTC)
utc.description: The release time in UTC (ISO 8601), converted from New York time for that date, so daylight saving is handled.

days_until.title: Days until
days_until.description: Whole days from the moment this actor fetched the data to the release; 0 means within the next 24 hours.

is_next.title: Next of its type
is_next.description: True for the first upcoming release of this type.

press_conference.title: Press conference
press_conference.description: For an FOMC decision, whether the chair holds a press conference. Empty for the other releases.

source_url.title: Official source
source_url.description: The Federal Reserve, BLS or BEA page the date was read from.

verified_at.title: Verified at
verified_at.description: When the data source last checked this date against the official page (ISO 8601, UTC).

fetched_at.title: Fetched at
fetched_at.description: When this actor fetched the data (ISO 8601, UTC).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per release: type, name, date and time in New York and UTC, days until, and the official source.
